Geometry · Unit 9: Coordinate Geometry

Distance Formula

d = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²), the Pythagorean theorem on a grid.

What you’ll learn

  • Find the distance between two points
  • Connect the distance formula to the Pythagorean theorem
  • Find perimeters on a grid

The mountain biking connection

Straight-line distance between two points on a trail map grid.
